name: The Benjamin Royal Sonesta
insider_take: This Midtown East gem sits on the legendary "Dream Street" where guests once included Marilyn Monroe and Joe DiMaggio during their honeymoon stay.
whats_special: The Benjamin is home to one of NYC's most unique amenities - a dedicated Sleep Concierge who helps guests achieve perfect rest with custom pillow menus, aromatherapy, and sleep-inducing treatments. The hotel also features the city's only pneumatic tube system still in operation, originally used to send messages between floors in the 1920s.
pro_tip: Book the Terrace Suite for exclusive access to a private 2,000-square-foot outdoor space - one of the largest hotel terraces in Manhattan with stunning Chrysler Building views.
dont_miss: Take a 3-minute walk to the hidden Greenacre Park, a secret waterfall oasis tucked between skyscrapers. The hotel's location puts you steps from Grand Central's Campbell Bar, a restored 1920s tycoon's office turned cocktail haven, and the historic Chrysler Building lobby tours.
pros: Prime Midtown East location near major attractions
Elegant Art Deco architecture and sophisticated design
Professional business facilities and meeting spaces
cons: Premium pricing typical of Manhattan luxury hotels
Busy Midtown location with city noise
